aboutParagraphs: InnerAnimalMedia builds developer tooling, autonomous agent infrastructure, and multi-domain publishing systems designed around clarity, determinism, and editorial restraint.

Across the AgentSam runtime, the ASBD design system, and the Plain Jane (IAPJ) theme architecture, every layer shares one rule: keep contracts explicit, eliminate fragile runtime assumptions, and pair generative capability with verifiable engineering discipline.
This journal serves as both our public engineering library and a canonical knowledge base for designing, benchmarking, and shipping resilient software.
